overview: SIM-swap, subscription, IRSF and SMS fraud drain revenue directly, and every successful attack erodes subscriber trust as well — a cost that outlasts the fraud itself. Real-Time Fraud Detection scores provisioning events, SIM-change requests and call and SMS bursts as they happen, blocking the highest-risk actions automatically and routing the rest to fraud operations with the evidence attached. Carrier-scale programmes have reported attacks down by as much as eighty percent. Auto-block thresholds stay under the operator's control, and manual fraud-ops load falls as triage narrows. The five-to-six week MVP runs on the operator's own provisioning and CDR streams, measuring detection latency and fraud loss against the pre-build baseline.
